name: Polycube
what_it_is: Polycube is an open source Linux software framework that provides fast, lightweight, eBPF/XDP-based network functions (bridge, router, firewall, NAT, load balancer, DDoS mitigator, and more) composable into arbitrary service chains. It exposes a REST daemon (polycubed) and a CLI (polycubectl) for managing the full virtual network topology.
components: polycubed — system daemon, REST API server (default port 9000), manages lifecycle of all cubes
polycubectl — service-agnostic CLI backed by Go, interacts with polycubed
libpolycube — shared library for service chaining, eBPF map access, logging
pcn-router — Layer-3 IP router with longest-prefix match
pcn-firewall — stateful packet filtering transparent cube
pcn-nat — Network Address Translation transparent cube
pcn-ddosmitigator — DDoS traffic mitigation transparent cube
pcn-dynmon — dynamic network monitor; injects arbitrary eBPF code at runtime, exports metrics as JSON or OpenMetrics
pcn-synflood — SYN flood detection monitor, exports TCP/IP metrics
pcn-k8s — full Kubernetes CNI plugin (bridging, routing, NAT, load balancing, tunneling)
protocols: XDP — eXpress Data Path (earliest kernel intercept point)
eBPF — Extended Berkeley Packet Filter (kernel data plane)
RESTCONF over HTTP/HTTPS (northbound API, YANG data models)
measurement: pcn-dynmon: exports eBPF map contents as JSON or OpenMetrics (Prometheus-compatible); supports INGRESS and EGRESS programs independently; atomic map reads via map-swap technique
pcn-synflood: exports tcpAttemptFails, tcpOutRsts, deliverRatio, responseRatio for SYN-flood detection
polycubed REST API: per-service statistics and state queryable at runtime via GET endpoints
polycubectl: CLI commands to show metrics (e.g., polycubectl monitor metrics show)
configuration: Persistence: --cubes-dump-enable saves topology to /etc/polycube/cubes.yaml and reloads on restart; --cubes-dump-file for custom path; --cubes-dump-clean-init for empty start
YANG data models describe each service's management interface; polycubectl auto-generates compatible commands from YANG
Each cube configured via REST PUT/PATCH to its own endpoint or via polycubectl subcommands
pcn-dynmon dataplane configured by PUT JSON to /dataplane-config REST endpoint (not via polycubectl)
fault_injection: No dedicated fault injection service is present in the framework
pcn-synflood monitors for SYN flood conditions but does not inject them
pcn-ddosmitigator mitigates DDoS but does not generate attack traffic
Custom eBPF code injected via pcn-dynmon could implement arbitrary packet manipulation, but no ready-made fault injection cube exists
modes: Standard cube mode: cubes with forwarding ports (e.g., bridge, router); connected port-to-port
Transparent cube mode: cubes without ports, attached to existing ports or netdevs; processes ingress and/or egress traffic only
Local service mode: cube implemented as shared library loaded in-process by polycubed
Remote service mode: cube implemented as a separate daemon, communicates with polycubed via gRPC
Docker mode: run polycubed inside privileged container with --network host and kernel module mounts
Bare metal / systemd mode: polycubed installed natively, managed via systemctl
Persistent topology mode: --cubes-dump-enable restores full topology after daemon restart
constraints: Requires Linux kernel >= 4.15 for most services; kernel >= 5.4 recommended; XDP and eBPF features are Linux-only — no macOS or Windows support
Docker container must run in privileged mode (--privileged) with --network host; reduced-privilege containers cannot use eBPF
Only one polycubed instance allowed system-wide; requires root privileges
pcn-dynmon OpenMetrics export only supports simple value types; structs and unions are not exported; Histogram and Summary metric types not supported
pcn-dynmon batch map operations supported only for BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH, BPF_MAP_TYPE_LRU_HASH, and BPF_MAP_TYPE_ARRAY
Topology persistence (cubes-dump) does not support YANG actions (e.g., firewall/NAT rule append), some services fail full config reload, and transparent services on netdevs are not saved
pcn-synflood can only monitor the local host; cannot operate as a man-in-the-middle inspector for remote host traffic
eBPF data plane programs have size limits; complex processing must be offloaded to user-space slow path
Installation tested on Ubuntu >= 18.04; llvm 6.0 must be removed before running install script
No docker-compose file present in the repository; deployment is via a single privileged docker run command or bare-metal install
docker_services: Both images run polycubed daemon internally; started with: docker run -it --rm --privileged --network host -v /lib/modules:/lib/modules:ro -v /usr/src:/usr/src:ro -v /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro <image> /bin/bash -c 'polycubed -d && /bin/bash'
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml file in the repository; single-container privileged run only
No built-in fault injection cube or traffic generation service
No Windows or macOS support; Linux-only due to eBPF/XDP kernel dependency
No native OpenTelemetry or distributed tracing integration
No built-in GUI or web dashboard; management is CLI and REST only
No multi-node orchestration beyond pcn-k8s Kubernetes CNI; no standalone cluster management
YANG action types (append-style rule management) are not saved by the persistence subsystem
